profile.name: 通用套接字通信组件
profile.description: 这是一个非实体的软件通信组件，用于通过 TCP/IP 套接字与实验设备建立直接连接。它负责连接指定 IP 与端口，并处理命令写入、数据读取、查询收发，以及编码和读写终止符管理，常用于网络接口仪器的基础通信。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component for direct TCP/IP socket communication with laboratory devices. It opens a connection to a specified IP address and port and handles command writing, data reading, request-response queries, as well as encoding and read/write termination management for network-connected instruments.

registry.name: Open Standard General direct socket TL implementation
registry.description: Socket是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、写入数据、初始化、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, query等操作。
